name: open-artifacts
description: Create, publish, and revise private interactive artifacts with a shared Geist foundation.

interface.shortDescription: Make artifacts. Read comments. Publish revisions.
interface.longDescription: Create and revise private interactive artifacts with one shared Geist workflow. Choose Sites or Tailscale once during setup. Sites uses a signed-in browser; Tailscale uses native MCP or a portable file client without a browser. Existing artifact links stay with their original host.
defaultPrompt: Create an interactive artifact with Open Artifacts.
Revise this artifact using its open comments.
